title: Which jump sizes land on twenty four?
description: A treasure sits on twenty four and a jumper jumps in equal steps from zero. Testing jump sizes shows eight that land on it, and such numbers are called factors. Keeko's doubt, that one and twenty four do not count, is broken.
teaching_notes: One idea: a jump size that lands exactly on a number is a factor of it, and the factors come in pairs that multiply to the number. Watch for students who leave out one and the number itself.

source: Grumpy places a treasure on 24. Which jump sizes will get Ju
video_script.why: The child tests jump sizes on a treasure at twenty four, finds that sizes come in pairs, and meets the name factor.
video_script.substitution: A jump size lands on a number when some number of jumps times the size makes that number.
video_script.anchor: the treasure game of the book: Jia places a treasure on twenty four and Ziva jumps in equal steps
video_script.wrong_answer: one and twenty four do not count
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says one and twenty four do not count. A jump of one lands on every number and a jump of twenty four lands on twenty four in one leap, so the doubt is struck.
video_script.payoff_line: The jump sizes are one, two, three, four, six, eight, twelve and twenty four

final_answer.spoken: the jump sizes are one, two, three, four, six, eight, twelve and twenty four, called the factors of twenty four

names.Jia: places the treasures on numbers in the treasure game
names.Ziva: jumps in equal steps from zero in the treasure game

maths_rules: jumps of 2, 3, 6, 8, 12 also land on 24: 2 x 12, 3 x 8, 6 x 4, 8 x 3, 12 x 2
jump 5 goes 20, 25 and jump 7 goes 21, 28: both miss 24
jump 1 lands on every number; jump 24 lands on 24 in one leap
a number that lands exactly on 24 is called a factor of 24
video_script.design: One idea: the jump sizes that land on a number are its factors, and they come in pairs. Assumes skip counting and multiples. Wrong idea: one and the number itself do not count. The row stays on the board to the end.
